Highlights

Chinese Landscape Jacquard Tote Bag
A distinctive black and ivory jacquard tote inspired by the quiet beauty of traditional Chinese ink-wash landscape art.
The woven design features layered mountains, pine trees, traditional architecture and misty landscape scenery rendered in a monochrome palette. Long black double handles frame the artwork and create a clean contrast against the light woven background.
With its simple rectangular silhouette and detailed landscape pattern, this bag combines an artistic East Asian aesthetic with an easy everyday tote shape.

PRODUCT DETAILS
- Color: Ivory / Black / Gray
- Exterior: Jacquard fabric
- Lining: Canvas
- Pattern: Chinese landscape / mountain scenery
- Closure: Magnetic closure
- Interior: 1 slip pocket + 1 zip pocket
- Carry Style: Shoulder carry / hand carry
- Shape: Rectangular tote
- Style: Chinese-inspired / Artistic / Monochrome

SIZE
- Bag width: approx. 32 cm / 12.6 in
- Bag height: approx. 32 cm / 12.6 in
- Shoulder strap length: approx. 60 cm / 23.6 in
Please allow slight measurement differences due to manual measuring.

DESIGN
The ivory woven surface is decorated with softly shimmering floral motifs that become especially beautiful under natural light. Rather than a heavily structured handbag, this design has a relaxed silhouette that naturally drapes when carried.
The neutral cream-and-gold palette makes it easy to pair with linen, knitwear, dresses, neutral outfits, and simple everyday looks.

PLEASE NOTE
Colors may appear slightly different depending on lighting and screen settings. The placement of the woven floral pattern may also vary slightly from bag to bag.

details:
Highlights
Materials: Stone

Add a natural sculptural accent to cabinets, drawers, dressers, wardrobes, and bedside tables with this stone cabinet knob. Each knob features a cube-like natural stone body with organic pores and texture, paired with a metal mounting base for a clean, earthy look. It works well with wabi-sabi, rustic, minimalist, Mediterranean, and natural interior styles.

There are 4 color options: White, Beige, Taupe, and Terracotta. All four colors use the same size. The stone is naturally porous and irregular, so each piece will vary slightly in pore pattern, texture, color depth, edge shape, and surface details.

Prodcut Details
Material: Natural Travertine Marble, Brass Nut, Alloy Screw
Size:35×35×35‑40mm, Single Hole, 70‑100g per piece
Craft: Screw tenon joint with structural glue
Application: Drawer, Cabinet, Wardrobe, Sideboard
Note: Natural stone, texture, pores & color vary on each knob
Screw Length Guide

Please choose the screw length according to your door or drawer panel thickness:

1–1.5 cm panel → 2 cm screw
1.5–2 cm panel → 2.5 cm screw
2–2.5 cm panel → 3 cm screw
2.5–3 cm panel → 3.5 cm screw
3–3.5 cm panel → 4 cm screw
3.5–4 cm panel → 4.5 cm screw
4–4.5 cm panel → 5 cm screw
Important Notes
The listed price includes one knob only.
All colors are the same general size.
A 2.5 cm screw is sent by default unless another length is requested.
If your panel thickness is different, please select the correct screw length.
Natural stone pieces are not identical; pores, texture, color variation, and irregular edges are normal characteristics.
Small pits, holes, rough areas, and uneven surfaces are part of the natural look and are not defects.
Please measure your cabinet or drawer thickness before ordering.
Do not overtighten the screw, as excessive pressure may damage the stone or loosen the structure.
Clean gently with a soft dry or slightly damp cloth.
Avoid prolonged soaking, harsh chemicals, and abrasive cleaners.
Colors may appear slightly different because of lighting and screen settings.

Product safety:

Decorative furniture hardware only. Not a toy. Contains a screw and small components that may present a choking hazard. Keep away from babies, young children, and pets. Natural stone may contain pores, rough areas, and fragile edges, and may chip or crack if dropped or struck. Handle carefully during installation and use. Make sure the knob is securely installed before use. Select the correct screw length for your panel thickness and do not overtighten the screw. Inspect the stone, mounting base, and screw regularly, and stop using the product if any part becomes loose, cracked, or damaged. Keep away from open flames, excessive heat, and harsh chemicals.

Highlights
Made by NngGoods
Materials: Crystal, rock crystal

Add a natural, sculptural accent to cabinets, drawers, dressers, wardrobes, nightstands, and other furniture with this white veined stone knob. The polished irregular stone face features organic brown and gray veining, paired with a gold-tone metal base for a refined yet earthy look. It complements modern, bohemian, rustic, minimalist, and nature-inspired interiors.

This listing includes one cabinet knob and one mounting screw. The stone is available in one approximate size range:

Stone face: approximately 45–60 mm
Projection/depth shown: approximately 24 mm

Because the stone is naturally patterned and individually shaped, each knob will vary slightly in outline, veining, color distribution, thickness, and surface appearance.

Important Notes
The listed price includes one knob and one mounting screw.
Only one stone style and one approximate size range are available.
Natural stone variations mean the item received will not be identical to the photographed sample.
Veining, mineral lines, small pits, irregular contours, and slight color differences are normal characteristics, not defects.
Please measure your furniture panel and confirm that the supplied screw is suitable before ordering.
Do not overtighten the screw, as excessive pressure may crack the stone or loosen the metal base.
Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid soaking, abrasive cleaners, and harsh chemicals.
Colors may appear slightly different due to lighting and screen settings.
The exact mineral type should be confirmed before describing it as howlite, turquoise, marble, or another specific stone.

Product safety:

Decorative furniture hardware only. Not a toy. Contains a mounting screw and small components that may present a choking hazard. Keep away from babies, young children, and pets. Natural stone may have irregular or slightly sharp edges and may chip or break if dropped or struck. Handle carefully during installation. Confirm that the supplied screw is suitable for the furniture panel and do not overtighten it. Inspect the stone, metal base, and screw regularly. Stop using the product if any component becomes cracked, loose, damaged, or detached. Keep away from open flames, excessive heat, and harsh chemicals.
